research_question: Why did the Exp019 sum of separately evaluated Fourier-component residuals fail to reconstruct the discrepancy of a full calc_kan_layer_fprop call?
observations: Exp019 reconstruction MAE was approximately as large as the observed full-layer logit error.
The documented KAN-style expression is a sum over input channels and Fourier components, so an additive decomposition should be tested directly before further model-level interventions.
A small synthetic ladder can distinguish a diagnostic implementation error from backend behaviour without retraining neural networks.
hypothesis: For controlled synthetic inputs, a full calc_kan_layer_fprop output will be numerically close to the sum of equivalent calls partitioned by Fourier component and by input channel when each partition uses matching sliced phis, amplitudes and ks.
falsification_criterion: The additivity hypothesis is weakened if full-call versus partitioned-call error becomes materially larger than ordinary bfloat16-scale numerical variation at a reproducible dimensionality, despite mathematically equivalent sliced inputs and parameters.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
Synthetic dimensions are much smaller than the full FashionMNIST layer.
If additivity holds, a separate follow-up will be needed to identify the Exp019 implementation mismatch.
